scope.evidence_limit: Source/contract validation is measured locally; target latency and numerical rows remain future sm_120 measurements.

mechanism: CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel advertises kFp8DynamicTokenSym as an externally consumable activation contract.
Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod exposes the selected kernel contract on the concrete QKVParallelLinear layer.
Gemma4DecoderLayer routes input_layernorm(residual) directly through rms_norm_dynamic_per_token_quant when self_attn.qkv_proj advertises that contract.
The resulting QuantizedActivation is consumed by the existing FP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.apply_weights path; CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.apply_scaled_mm and ops.cutlass_scaled_mm are unchanged.
Non-CUTLASS, mismatched dtype/layout, variance override, and VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT paths retain the stock BF16 RMSNorm fallback.

exact_boundary.recurrence: Once per text decoder layer, 60 times per model forward.
exact_boundary.phase: The same boundary runs in prefill and decode; M is the flattened active-token row count.

prefill_geometry.m: 1..65536 scheduled active tokens; future oracle uses 2048 as the production chunk discriminator

layout_and_scale.norm_weight: BF16 [5376], epsilon=1e-6, standard RMSNorm weight semantics
layout_and_scale.activation_scale: FP32 dynamic per-token [M,1], direct dequantization scale
layout_and_scale.weight: OCP E4M3 FP8 CUTLASS column-major logical [K,N], one static FP32 per-tensor scale for online-FP8
layout_and_scale.accumulation_and_output: Stock CUTLASS scaled GEMM accumulation, BF16 output

existing_fusion_boundary.why_disabled: The measured runtime used optimization level O0 semantics: pass_config.fuse_norm_quant=false and fuse_act_quant=false, so RMSNormQuantFusionPass was not installed. At O1+ official vLLM can pattern-match RMSNorm followed by visible QuantFP8, but the live O0 path materializes BF16.
existing_fusion_boundary.why_manual_bridge_was_inapplicable: Official v0.26.0 contains QuantizedActivation plumbing, but Fp8PerTensorOnlineLinearMethod never calls expose_input_quant_key and CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel accepts external prequantization only for static per-tensor activation. Therefore the dynamic per-token online-FP8 QKV consumer cannot receive the shipped fused norm output.
existing_fusion_boundary.source_history: The QuantizedActivation contract was introduced by official commit c90650088dafc8ad5fc372b412b67170c5ad3f4a (#44260); this patch extends that proven contract rather than creating a parallel GEMM.

physical_prediction.saved_bytes_formula: BF16 norm output write plus quantizer read = 2 * M * K * sizeof(BF16) = 4*M*K bytes; FP8 output, FP32 scale, norm input/weight, and GEMM traffic are common.
physical_prediction.label: analytical compulsory-byte and launch-count prediction; cache residency and endpoint transfer remain unmeasured

framework_oracle.stock_path: RMSNorm -> CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.apply_weights, which invokes its stock QuantFP8 producer and unchanged CUTLASS GEMM.
framework_oracle.candidate_path: rms_norm_to_fp8_linear -> QuantizedActivation -> the same CutlassFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel.apply_weights and unchanged CUTLASS GEMM.
framework_oracle.consumption: Every timed output is fully reduced after the CUDA end event; first untimed stock and candidate outputs are synchronized and compared before timing.

gates.identity: device capability (12,0), vLLM version prefix 0.26.0, and Torch exactly 2.11.0+cu130

required_project_local_wheel.note: Materialize and verify this immutable wheel under the project before any future bench claim.

future_sm120_build_and_run.command:
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT=/workspace/gemma4_vllm026_sm120_norm_fp8_fusion
SRC=/workspace/vllm-v0.26.0-norm-fp8
PY=/workspace/vllm-sm120-norm-fp8/bin/python
WHEEL="$PROJECT/inputs/vllm-0.26.0+cu129-cp38-abi3-manylinux_2_28_x86_64.whl"
test "$(sha256sum "$WHEEL" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 6ce4ca30616f0a35810391015622b197a7b8b267ed27f8716f0789db79ff578b
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git "$SRC"
git -C "$SRC" checkout --detach 568afb3a13806beb53bb2e6bd518269357b237c0
test "$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse HEAD)" = 568afb3a13806beb53bb2e6bd518269357b237c0
test "$(sha256sum "$PROJECT/implementation/vllm026_sm120_norm_fp8_fusion.patch" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 79b97e9d86442721ddd9925e9c103817b35374e1a30c5354cc4eb9568c8cc63f
git -C "$SRC" apply --check --unidiff-zero "$PROJECT/implementation/vllm026_sm120_norm_fp8_fusion.patch"
git -C "$SRC" apply --unidiff-zero "$PROJECT/implementation/vllm026_sm120_norm_fp8_fusion.patch"
uv venv /workspace/vllm-sm120-norm-fp8 --python 3.12
VLLM_PRECOMPILED_WHEEL_LOCATION="$WHEEL" VLLM_SKIP_PRECOMPILED_VERSION_SUFFIX=1 uv pip install --python "$PY" --editable "$SRC" --no-build-isolation --torch-backend=auto
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 "$PY" "$PROJECT/sm120_framework_oracle.py" --rows 1,32,33,2048 --warmup 10 --repeats 50 --output "$PROJECT/artifacts/SM120_FRAMEWORK_ORACLE.json"
future_sm120_build_and_run.required_path_proof: The candidate trace must contain rms_norm_dynamic_per_token_quant followed by the same cutlass_scaled_mm consumer; the stock range must contain separate RMSNorm and dynamic per-token FP8 quant launches.

not_claimed: No CUDA compiler resource or profiler counters
promotion.next_decision: If all oracle rows pass and the median component delta is positive, integrate the patch into the exact c32 server and measure the endpoint. Otherwise preserve the numerical/path rows as a typed target-GPU negative and do not claim the analytical byte bound as endpoint gain.
